metaDescription: Move-out cleaning for Pasadena homes, including older Craftsman and Spanish-revival properties. Fixed price range $255 to $480. See what's included.
intro: Moving out of a Pasadena rental or sale property means passing a walkthrough, and older Craftsman bungalows and Spanish-revival units often hide extra grime in original built-ins, tile, and hardwood floors that a quick wipe-down won't fix. A move-out clean covers every room top to bottom so you can hand over keys with confidence.
causes: Years of cooking grease and dust settle into original wood cabinetry and built-in shelving common in Craftsman kitchens.
Textured plaster walls and old stucco interiors trap dust and cobwebs in corners that standard cleaning misses.
Original hardwood or tile flooring in Spanish-revival units accumulates wax buildup and grime along baseboards and edges.
Older single-pane windows and their wood frames collect dust, dead insects, and grime in the tracks and sills.
Bathrooms with vintage tile and grout hold soap scum and mineral deposits that need more than a surface wipe.
whatProDoes: Clean and disinfect all bathroom fixtures, tile, grout lines, and vintage fixtures common in older Pasadena homes.
Wipe down interior cabinetry, built-in shelving, and drawers inside and out, including kitchen and bathroom units.
Sweep, mop, or vacuum all flooring, paying extra attention to baseboards and transitions between original hardwood and tile.
Clean interior windows, sills, and tracks, plus wipe down window frames and screens where accessible.
Dust and wipe all surfaces, light fixtures, switch plates, and remove cobwebs from corners and ceiling edges.
diyOrPro: A light move-out clean in a small, well-maintained unit can be handled yourself with basic supplies and a few hours of effort. Larger Craftsman or Spanish-revival homes with original finishes, deep-set grime, or landlord-required detailed checklists are better left to a pro who knows how to clean older surfaces without damaging them.
priceNote: This job runs $255 to $480 in Pasadena, based on a $56/hour rate and typical jobs taking 4 to 8 hours. Larger homes, heavier buildup in older kitchens and bathrooms, or extra detail work on original woodwork can push the job toward the higher end of that range.

faqs.q: Does this include cleaning inside the oven and refrigerator?
faqs.a: Appliance interiors are often part of a move-out clean, but confirm with your pro ahead of time since some listings price this separately depending on the home.

faqs.q: Will the cleaner handle carpet shampooing?
faqs.a: Standard move-out cleaning covers vacuuming and surface care, not deep carpet shampooing, which is usually a separate service if your unit has carpet instead of original hardwood.

faqs.q: Can this clean get my security deposit back?
faqs.a: A thorough move-out clean improves your chances by meeting typical landlord checklists, but final deposit decisions depend on your landlord's own inspection standards, not the cleaning service itself.
